notes.title: Ver 1.1.1
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that allowed you to sit on top of your uncle.
・Fixed a bug where you could go on top of a vehicle.
・Fixed a bug with the camera shake option.
・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Ver1.1.0
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that caused doors to open when sitting in a chair under certain conditions when it was not intended.
・A bug that allowed you to walk outside a train has been partially fixed.

notes.title: Ver1.0.9
notes.content: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused invisible enemies to appear under certain conditions that were not originally intended.

notes.title: Ver1.0.8
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug in which the camera acceleration settings were not reflected when the game was over.
・Adjustment of the appearance of some anomalies.

notes.title: Ver1.0.7
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused the back door to be opened before the front door was opened.

notes.title: Ver1.0.6
notes.content:
・The appearance of some anomalies has been adjusted.
・The option to skip the initial announcement has been added.

notes.title: Ver1.0.5
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented options from being saved.
・Fixed a bug that could cause the game to become unplayable when playing offline.
・Adjustments were made to the appearance of the game.

notes.title: PatchNote ver1.0.3
notes.content: Several minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.0.2
notes.content:
・The guide has been added to make it easier to understand the objectives of the game.
・The electric board is now a little easier to see when viewed from a distance.

notes.title: PatchNote Ver1.0.1
notes.content:
・Adjusted the size of the electric board a little larger.
・Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behaviour when sitting on a chair at certain times of some anomalies.

notes.title: Correction of English text
notes.content: Some English text was incorrect and has been corrected.
